MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The HD Fire TV Stick feels like a useful next step because it would add streaming to my Samsung 720p TV without requiring a new screen.",
    "The HDMI cable fits my pattern of buying practical connection accessories for equipment I already own; its length could give me more flexibility around my TV setup."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The smart plug and Echo devices introduce voice control without addressing a need I have expressed. Buying power strips and car mounts does not mean I want Alexa at home or in my car.",
    "The earbuds and six short Ethernet cables do not support an evident current need, while another small display feels unnecessary alongside my tablet.",
    "The 4K streaming stick offers little extra value for my listed 720p TV, and I would choose the latest HD option over the previous-generation stick."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning a Fire tablet seems to have been treated as interest in a whole range of Amazon devices, although my related purchases were storage, a case, and mounting accessories.",
    "My purchases of electronics accessories seem to have been interpreted as broad interest in new gadgets, rather than specific ways to connect, protect, store, or support existing equipment."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of memory cards, a card reader, and storage cases suggest ongoing needs around handling storage media.",
    "My tripods, tablet mount, and recent lens cap point toward practical camera and mounting needs that these recommendations barely address.",
    "Compatibility and a clear use matter: my TV's resolution, the connections my equipment supports, and the cable length or quantity I actually need affect whether an accessory is useful."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my TV setup but stretched my practical accessory purchases into an unsupported interest in Alexa devices and unrelated gadgets."
}
